Process

How a Sialkot project runs

1

Tell us about the space

Call, WhatsApp or email with drawings, photos or a rough idea. We shape the brief together.

2

Site visit or drawings review

We visit the site on a scheduled round from Lahore, or work from your drawings.

3

Concept & quantities

You see the design in 3D and approve itemized quantities before anything is built.

4

Build & handover

One team delivers the work and hands over a finished space that matches what you approved.

A local note

A note on working in Sialkot

Sialkot's export industry sets the standard here: offices, showrooms and owner homes with real pride in the detail. Clients often know exactly what they want visitors to see. We run these projects from Lahore with scheduled visits and clear milestones.
